thread:
Priya Patel: Hey team — dropping the product blog draft + a traffic playbook focused on conversions and webinar seat-mapping. Need copy review, benchmark narrative alignment, and final CTAs. Legal looped in for a quick pass. Draft here: https://drive.redwood/drafts/product-post-traffic-playbook (comments enabled).

Alex Chen: Skimmed the draft. Benchmark section needs clearer callouts — put the 95th pct latency and cost-per-1k tokens right under the headline. Also call out test workload (concurrent 50 users, 256 tokens) so numbers aren’t ambiguous.

Maya Ortiz: Q on the webinar seat-mapping: do we reserve demo slots for top-tier leads only, or a mix? I recommend we reserve 20% of slots for enterprise nurture (AE assigned) and open the rest for on-demand product sessions. That affects CTA language.

Sam Rivers: Agree with Maya. For routing: high-intent webinar signups -> SDR queue (tag: webinar-high), trial signups -> product trial flow, whitepaper downloads -> nurture drip. Sample UTM we’ll attach to CTAs: `?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=product_post_v1&utm_content=webinar_cta`.

Elaine K.: Quick legal note — two customer quotes mention pricing specifics. We need written approval from those customers before publishing or redact numbers. Also remove the client company name from the benchmark table until approvals are in. Otherwise fine.

Priya Patel: Good catch, Elaine. I’ll flag the quotes and swap in anonymized placeholders if approvals don’t land by EOD Thursday. Timeline proposal: publish Monday morning PST, webinar registration opens 48 hours after publish. Does that window work for content + legal?

Alex Chen: Works for engineering to freeze benchmark numbers today if Maya can confirm the final test vector. LGTM pending legal clearance and the tiny copy edits I’ll push in comments. :+1:

Maya Ortiz: Final test vector confirmed — 3 prompts (summarization, code completions, multi-turn chat), tokens capped at 256, concurrency 50. I’ll update the benchmark paragraph with a short explainer sentence. Also proposing two headline variants for A/B: 1) "Serve LLM Features at Predictable Cost and Latency" and 2) "Ship Faster LLM Experiences Without Surprises" — lean on variant 2 for PLG click performance.

Sam Rivers: I’ll prepare the traffic playbook entries for distribution channels: organic blog, newsletter, product in-app banner, and partner co-mail. Also will create the inbound routing snippet for ops: `route when: webinar-signup.intent>=0.8 -> queue: webinar-high`; simple JSON tag: `{"queue":"webinar-high","priority":"p1"}`.

Priya Patel: Perfect. Can everyone add final thumbs-up to comments in the doc by Friday 2pm PT? If legal approves earlier, we’ll swap the placeholder quotes back in. Social calendar will schedule posts across channels for Monday 09:00 PST.

Elaine K.: Will aim for quick-pass by Friday 11am PT. If we don’t have customer approval, let me know and I’ll sign off on the redacted copy.

Deploy-Bot: Social schedule queued: blog -> Monday 09:00 PST; newsletter -> Monday 12:00 PST.

Alex Chen: :thumbsup:

Priya Patel: Thanks all — I’ll make the edits and ping when final version is ready for sign-off.
